metadata.description: Claude Code skills and plugins for document and compliance workflows.

plugins.name: customer-service-skills
plugins.description: Skills for the Customer Service team. Holds upload-documents, which builds the workbook that attaches a folder of documents onto items that already exist in a Worldmaker app, reading each document to decide what kind of document it is.

plugins.name: util-skills
plugins.description: Building blocks other skills call. Holds extract-document-text, which turns document files into Markdown an agent can read using MarkItDown under uv, and renders the pages of scanned PDFs that hold no text.
